headline: African Gaming Franchise Rise of Fearless Raises $1 Million in Financing
summary: Rise of Fearless has secured $1 million in SAFE financing from Epic Edges Capital to expand its gaming franchise and target 100,000 active players.
why: Early-stage venture capital funding rounds support the expansion and scaling of emerging digital technology startups.
